verified_by_reviewer: BepiPred-3.0 baseline row recomputed independently: exact match
Nested BP3 result reproduced bit-exactly from the shipped module
No label leakage found in the leave-one-sequence-out loop

issues.summary: Routing-policy confidence intervals resample seeds on a fixed 15-antigen split, so they measure run-to-run dispersion, not sampling uncertainty over antigens. Antigen-level intervals are about 16x wider.
issues.fix: Recompute all routing intervals with a two-way bootstrap over antigens and seeds; restate the claims that do not survive.

history.note: pkg/policy_resampling.py written and running; tables and macros already wired to consume it.

issues.summary: Selective metric reporting: the 'no quality difference vs edge-only' claim rests on MCC alone, while the paper's own macros give dAUC -0.005 [-0.010,-0.001] and dAP -0.007 [-0.012,-0.002], both excluding zero and favouring edge-only.
issues.fix: Report all four quality metrics for every comparison; restate the claim to match.

history.note: table_paired_antigen now emits MCC, ROC-AUC, AP and F1 for every comparison with significance marks.

issues.summary: Carbon is dominated by the embodied per-request constant, not by latency; the stated mechanism ('the local pass is not negligible beside the remote pass') is contradicted by the model, where the local pass is 0.24% of the remote pass. The 'proportional to measured latency' sentence is false.
issues.fix: Correct the mechanism, give the operational/embodied split, and state that carbon differences are request-count differences.

history.note: Methods rewritten with generated macros for both terms; closed-form threshold added in results.

issues.summary: The six-decimal replication claim was never executed: the artifact recorded published_artifact_not_available.
issues.fix: Run the comparison against fusion_report.json and report the realised deviation, or weaken the claim.

history.note: Executed: 44 grid rows compared, max deviation 4.9e-07, within 1e-06 tolerance; status 'reproduced' recorded in the artifact and cited via macros.

issues.summary: The IEDB MCC/F1 null was diluted by 39 of 47 exactly-tied folds, so it rested on 8 informative antigens; the reported CI was about 5.6x too narrow, and the 'better powered' claim did not hold for MCC.
issues.fix: Report tie counts; report intervals over informative folds; restrict the better-powered claim to AUC and AP.

history.note: Root cause was R2-006. With the threshold fitted on training folds, IEDB MCC ties fell 39->8 and BP3 6->0. Tie counts now recorded in the artifacts.

issues.summary: The per-fold operating threshold was the quantile of the held-out antigen's own blended scores: transductive, not deployable, and contrary to the Methods description. No label leakage (confirmed by test and by reviewer).
issues.fix: Fit the threshold on the training folds' scores and apply it unchanged; correct the Methods sentence.

history.note: Fixed in code and text; all 14 tests still pass; fusion conclusions unchanged.

issues.summary: The --reference-threshold value that produced the headline results was not recorded in the artifacts, and the CLI default produces materially different numbers.
issues.fix: Record the threshold and its provenance in the report; document the exact invocations.

history.note: reference_threshold and operating_rate_source now written into every report and shown in the markdown header; regenerate.sh ships the exact invocations.

issues.summary: The code uses a training-fitted ECDF, not a global rank transform, so the stated ROC-AUC invariance does not hold; pooled out-of-fold ranking metrics mix per-fold scales.
issues.fix: Correct the Methods description; prefer per-fold paired metrics over the pooled row.

history.note: Methods now describes the training-fitted ECDF and states the residual effect explicitly.

issues.summary: A scenario/robustness analysis exists in the artifacts and is never reported, including an informative 'remote tier unavailable' result.
issues.fix: Report the scenario table and state which axes were varied and which were not.

history.note: table_scenarios written; to be referenced from the results section.

issues.summary: 'the most carbon-intensive policy we measure' uses measurement language for a modelled quantity.
Degenerate zero-width intervals printed as 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
issues.fix: Print them as deterministic, or replace with antigen-level intervals.

history.note: Superseded by R2-001: antigen-level intervals are non-degenerate.

issues.summary: The carbon inversion is an instance of the known offloading energy threshold (Kumar & Lu 2010, doi:10.1109/MC.2010.98), and has been observed for decoding cascades (arXiv:2602.09113).
issues.fix: Cite both; recast the contribution as locating the threshold for this task.

history.note: Cited in background and discussion; contribution 2 reworded; closed-form threshold added.

issues.summary: The carbon instrument follows Green Algorithms (doi:10.1002/advs.202100707), with a bioinformatics precedent (doi:10.1093/molbev/msac034); neither was cited.
issues.fix: Cite both and state that the energy model follows that formulation.

issues.summary: The nested-selection correction re-demonstrates a result established in bioinformatics by Varma & Simon (2006) and Jelizarow et al. (2010).
issues.fix: Cite them; reframe the contribution as an instance rather than a method.

history.note: Discussion now says so explicitly and promotes the interval-does-not-protect point as the distinct contribution.

issues.summary: The manuscript did not say where the earlier fusion result was reported, so a reader could take it for a published correction.
issues.fix: State plainly that it was unpublished and scope the claim.

issues.summary: Related work missed 2024-2026 conformational predictors: SEMA 2.0, Israeli & Louzoun, and the Gabellieri et al. 2026 review.
issues.fix: Add them; use the 2026 review as the survey anchor.

history.note: All three cited; note that the reviewer's title for the Israeli & Louzoun DOI was wrong and was corrected against the record.

issues.summary: 'Benchmark' oversells a single 15-antigen split; AsEP (arXiv:2407.18184) is the point of contrast for scale.
issues.fix: Call it a measurement harness and cite AsEP.

issues.summary: The IEDB subset's provenance block names the DTU BP3C50ID files while pointing at IEDB subset paths; the better-powered leg of the fusion result rests on it. RESOLVED: the subset derives from IEDBSeqsNotSharedAt20ID.fasta (3560 IEDB sequences filtered to <=20% identity against BP3), length-bounded to 45-595 residues. All 252 subset sequences are present verbatim in that source.
issues.fix: Provenance documented in the datasets section; independence verified directly (0 shared identifiers, 0 shared sequences, 0.000 max 10-mer containment against all 358 BP3 sequences). The artifact's mislabelled data_sources block is fixed in edgeconbce_real_benchmark_v2.py. Only the sampling rule remains unrecorded.

history.note: Blocker for submission. Flagged in methods, limitations and PROGRESS.md as a PENDING for the author.
Source identified and independence measured three ways.

issues.summary: The embodied constants implied by the recorded per-antigen totals (0.1200 local, 0.1381 remote) do not match those declared in the stored device configuration (0.6000, 0.2125), and the two discrepancies are not a common factor. RESOLVED: the embodied term carries a device-utilisation fraction (0.20 local, 0.65 edge) applied as a literal in the benchmark script and recorded in no configuration. With it the recorded totals reproduce to 0e+00 gCO2e across all 47 antigens checked.
issues.fix: Documented in the cost-accounting section with a sensitivity analysis; the fractions are now written into the artifact by real_benchmark.py. Lifting them into the YAML config remains a follow-up.

history.note: Found during this session's own carbon decomposition, independently of the panel. Policy ordering is unaffected; absolute values are not reproducible from the stored config.
